name: Grookey
description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.description: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Branch Poke
moves.description: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the target’s held item, and that item can’t be used in that battle. The move does more damage if the target has a held item.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: This attack move cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light’s energy, attacking the target on the next turn.

moves.name: Grass Pledge
moves.description: A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water equivalent, its power increases and a vast swamp appears.

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: The user’s body grows all at once, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn each time the user enters battle.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.description: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.description: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target’s Ability Insomnia.
